title: Improving Text Analysis Using Sentence Conjunctions and Punctuation
eligible_reason: Methodological topic-model paper (sticky / sentence-constrained LDA using conjunctions and punctuation) applied to review text. No treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: R scripts estimate supervised LDA, SC-LDA and sticky LDA variants by MCMC on four review corpora (We8There, Expedia NY luxury hotels, Amazon tents, Amazon dog food), regressing ratings on topic shares within the model.
data_files: Expedia NY Luxury Hotel 1060words with covariates.RData
data_files_note: Processed review text corpora with conjunction/punctuation covariates.
data_provenance_note: Processed review text as used in the paper.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
